name: Strate School of Design
description:
Are you looking to study at one of the best design schools in the world?

Do you want to study at an institution well-known for creativity, innovation, and design excellence? Then, the Strate School of Design is your best choice.

Renowned for its design programs and faculty, Strate School of Design brings out its studentâ€™s potential to succeed in design.

Founded in 1993, Strate is one of the best institutions for design in France and the world.

Strate School of Design offers several programs, including transportation, industrial, and interaction design. From undergraduate degrees to master's programs and professional certificates, Strate provides students with the design skills and tools to thrive in today's dynamic design industry.

Want to know more? Discover why the Strate School of Design might be the place for you!

Strate School of Design was founded in 1993 in Paris. Strate offers a hands-on and dynamic approach to design education.

The institute boasts over 50 professors, researchers, and industry professionals, with a strong foundation in design thinking and creative expression. Students at the Strate School of Design work with partner organisations and industry professionals during their studies.

Located in the heart of Paris, Strate's campus offers modern facilities. It features design studios, workshops, and prototyping labs for design and innovation. Additionally, Strate School of Design Paris partners with leading design firms and research institutions, offering students internship and collaboration opportunities.

Why Strate School of Design?

  • Strate School of Design offers several programs, including transportation, industrial, and interaction design at undergraduate, master's programs and professional certificates.
  • Strate offers a hands-on and dynamic approach to design education and is one of the best design schools in the world.
  • The institute offers modern facilities for design and innovation, and partners with leading design firms and research institutions.

Student Life

Strate School of Design offers a supportive and collaborative environment for students. Beyond the classroom, the institute encourages students to participate in design competitions, exhibitions, and industry events. 

The institution also organises guest lectures, design events, and networking opportunities for professional development.

Strate School of Design is situated in the vibrant city of Paris, close to design studios, galleries, and creative centres. Students can enjoy a wide range of food, entertainment, and recreational activities surrounding the campus.
